scenes.caption: Spring.
scenes.say: In spring, blossom opens and lambs skip in the fields.

scenes.caption: Summer.
scenes.say: In summer it is hot and the days are long. She wears a sun hat.

scenes.caption: Monsoon.
scenes.say: In July the monsoon arrives. Heavy rain fills the streets.

scenes.caption: Autumn.
scenes.say: In autumn, leaves turn red and gold and fall to the ground.

scenes.caption: Winter.
scenes.say: In winter it is cold. The northern mountains are covered in snow.

scenes.caption: Daylight.
scenes.say: Winter days are short. The sun sets early and the nights are long.

scenes.caption: Thermometer.
scenes.say: A thermometer shows how hot or cold it is. Today it reads ten degrees.

scenes.caption: Dress for it.
scenes.say: Zainab dresses for the weather. SubhanAllah, every season has its gifts!
